title: AASIA: A comprehensive protein structural interactome database for agricultural animals.
authors: Li, Jiajun; Yuan, Mengdi; Jiang, Linyang; Li, Dianke; Yin, Zhongtao; Zhu, Feng; Shi, Wenyu; Hou, Zhuocheng; Zhang, Ziding
one_liner_zh: 该文构建了农业动物蛋白质结构互作组数据库，利用深度学习预测PPI并生成复合物结构，虽非核心方法创新，但涉及蛋白质结构计算建模，对结构互作组研究有参考价值。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Agricultural animals are essential for global food production and sustainable agriculture. Improving disease resistance and economically important traits is critical for ensuring food security. Proteome-wide protein-protein interactions (PPIs), termed as interactomes, underlie key biological processes in cells, making them critical for deciphering the genome-phenome relationship. However, species-specific PPI resources remain limited for most agricultural animals. OBJECTIVES: Motivated by the rapid development of deep learning and breakthroughs in AI-driven protein structure prediction, we attempted to develop an integrated structural interactome resource for agricultural animals. METHODS: We predicted species-specific interactomes through an integrative prediction pipeline that combines interolog mapping, domain-domain interaction inference, and deep learning. The 3D complex structures of all predicted PPIs were further generated using ESMFold. RESULTS: We established AASIA (Agricultural Animals Structural Interactome Atlas; https://aasia.zzdlab.com), a user-friendly database comprising 410,421 high-confidence PPIs and corresponding complex structures across five key species, including Anas platyrhynchos, Bos taurus, Gallus gallus, Ovis aries, and Sus scrofa. CONCLUSIONS: AASIA provides the first proteome-scale structural interactome resource for five key agricultural animals. By integrating interaction prediction with structural modeling, it enables mechanistic insight into agriculturally relevant traits and supports applications in variant interpretation, multi-omics integration, and molecular breeding.
abstract_zh: 引言：农业动物对全球粮食生产和可持续农业至关重要。提高抗病性和经济重要性状对于确保粮食安全十分关键。全蛋白质组范围内的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs），称为相互作用组（interactomes），是细胞中关键生物过程的基础，因此对于解读基因组-表型组关系具有重要意义。然而，大多数农业动物的物种特异性PPI资源仍然有限。目标：受深度学习快速发展和AI驱动的蛋白质结构预测突破的启发，我们试图为农业动物开发一个整合的结构性相互作用组资源。方法：我们通过一个整合预测流程预测了物种特异性相互作用组，该流程结合了interolog映射、结构域-结构域相互作用推断和深度学习。所有预测PPIs的三维复合物结构进一步使用ESMFold生成。结果：我们建立了AASIA（农业动物结构性相互作用组图谱；https://aasia.zzdlab.com），这是一个用户友好的数据库，包含五个关键物种的410,421个高置信度PPIs及相应的复合物结构，这些物种包括绿头鸭（Anas platyrhynchos）、家牛（Bos taurus）、原鸡（Gallus gallus）、绵羊（Ovis aries）和家猪（Sus scrofa）。结论：AASIA为五种关键农业动物提供了首个蛋白质组规模的结构性相互作用组资源。通过将相互作用预测与结构建模相结合，它能够对农业相关性状提供机制性见解，并支持在变异解读、多组学整合和分子育种中的应用。
